matrix_note: ratio is the price weighted spend (list price, cache included) of the run alone over the run with the skill, which is what the quota and the bill follow; token_ratio is kept for reference only. One run per cell and arm, so a single cell is noisy; the footer uses 'pooled' (spend summed over every measured effort of that model and kind). Cells marked interpolated were not run and carry the pooled ratio.
agy_note: Claude Opus 5.5 high, 3 runs per arm; agy tokens are reported apart. The Gemini CLI was not logged in, so it was not measured.

router.note: Dynamic uses fewer tokens than the fixed table and than no routing, at equal or better quality. The table costs fewer dollars because it sends reading to haiku.
